verdict.rationale: Fastmail's own server-side Filters & Rules, including flexible Sieve filters, act on incoming mail without user involvement. Snooze and Scheduled Send also carry out one-off timed actions in the background. These are rule-based triggers on mail arrival or single scheduled events, not general autonomous or agentic automation, and a user reports filters don't apply to existing mail. Missing for 10: documented detail on what filter automations can do, recurring or scheduled workflows beyond one-off snooze/send, AI-driven or agentic background automation, and hands-on corroboration of automation depth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
